blindness_caveat: Built 2026-10-13 from press coverage and the Wikipedia acquisitions table only, before any CrowdStrike SEC filing text or Helix output was fetched or inspected. PARTIAL because: (1) completion was verified only for Preempt, Humio and SecureCircle, and only from press-release headlines/titles, not full text; (2) the seven later deals are recorded as AGREED_TO_ACQUIRE (announcement) with NO closing event, because no completion announcement was found for them -- do not add ACQUIRED events without checking; (3) month-level dates come from a single Wikipedia table and prices differ between sources (SGNL: $740M vs $750M) so no prices are asserted.
note: Chosen as a CURRENT domestic filer (CIK 1535527; first SEC filing is its 2019 S-1) with a long run of mostly small deals -- the case where an 8-K Item 1.01/2.01 gate is most likely to miss, since small tuck-ins are often disclosed only in the 10-K/10-Q or press releases. Includes an EASM vendor (Reposify), which is on-topic for ASM seed generation. Excluded on purpose: Payload Security (Nov 2017, before CrowdStrike was a registrant -- a coverage test, not an extraction test, per the Trump lesson); Pangea (recalled as ~Sep 2025 but not corroborated in this research); Orion (reported as talks only). Note Onum rests on a single secondary source (Wikipedia).
